description: This file contains a Scala.js web application implementing a TodoMVC app using the binding-scala library. It defines the main application logic, data models, UI components, event handlers, and persistence logic for a to-do list.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: A class representing a to-do item with a title and completion status, not a case class to distinguish duplicates by content.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: A case class representing a list of todos with a label, URL hash, and items.

methods.name: Todo.apply
methods.description: Factory method to create a new Todo instance.

methods.name: Todo.unapply
methods.description: Extractor for pattern matching on Todo instances.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of todos from local storage.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current list of todos to local storage.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Renders the header UI component with input for adding new todos.

methods.name: todoListItem
methods.description: Renders a list item for a single todo with toggle, edit, and delete functionality.

methods.name: mainSection
methods.description: Renders the main section with toggle-all checkbox and list of current todos.

methods.name: footer
methods.description: Renders the footer with filters, counters, and clear completed button.

methods.name: todoapp
methods.description: Assembles the entire app UI from header, main, and footer components.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entrypoint method invoked from JavaScript to render the app into the DOM.
